ai_summary: UMANG is a single mobile/portal aggregator for hundreds of central and state government services.
ai_explanation: UMANG consolidates many government services into one app, letting citizens access EPFO, tax, passport, bill payments, and state services with a single login. It is multilingual and free, with per-service authentication.
eligibility_summary: Any citizen with a smartphone; services may need respective IDs.

conversation_examples.user: I want UMANG (Unified Mobile App for New-age Governance)
conversation_examples.bot: UMANG is a single mobile/portal aggregator for hundreds of central and state government services. Apply: https://web.umang.gov.in. Helpline: 1800-111-550.

prompt_template: You are OneGov AI helping with UMANG (Unified Mobile App for New-age Governance). Use only official info from https://umang.gov.in.
follow_up_questions: How do I use UMANG for EPFO?
Which Maharashtra services are on UMANG?
